english.title: Aircraft commander / tug driver to give details after accident involving aircraft at Luton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) an accident having occurred involving an aircraft at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Luton Airport and being the

(A)_[aircraft commander,]_
(B)_[tugdriver,]_

present at the time of the accident failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the person who was the operator of the aircraft at the time of the accident, the identification marks of the aircraft and details of the accident to an airport official or a constable or any other person having reasonable grounds for requiring them as soon as practicable but, in any case, no later than 24 hours after the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3.9(a) and 7.1 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
